{{Hatnote|1=Working documentation of the typefaces on Star Wars CCG cards. Started 2026-10-12 by Holocron Claude from Bardez's template notes and measurements of printed cards, PC Holotable images and the PC Remaster slip sheets. Nothing here is an official Decipher or Players Committee statement; corrections welcome.}}
The typefaces of the Star Wars CCG were never documented by Decipher. Known identifications come from the printed cards, the [[Players Committee]]'s Holotable card images and the font notes [[Bardez]] made for his 600&nbsp;DPI card templates (2021, see [[Making Custom SWCCG Cards]]). The Holotable images re-typeset the virtual sets in the same faces. The open-source [https://github.com/billbisco/swccg-cardmaker swccg-cardmaker] program behind the [[Original Virtual Set 3 remaster review|Original Virtual Set remasters]] follows these faces.

== The faces ==
{| class="wikitable"
! Element !! Typeface !! Notes
|-
| Card title || Fiorello CG Condensed || Decipher 1995–2001 and the PC alike. Also used for the deploy and forfeit numbers in the small boxes left of the game text.
|-
| Lore || Akzidenz-Grotesk BQ Light Condensed || Left-aligned, first line indented, on every printed card checked (Premiere–Endor). Bold is used for a characteristic word in lore (e.g. ''leader'', ''smuggler'', ''spy'').
|-
| Game text || Akzidenz-Grotesk BQ Condensed (regular weight) || The PC's Holotable cards print game text at 62&nbsp;px / 65&nbsp;px line in 600&nbsp;DPI terms (measured on Chewbacca (V), Virtual Set 13). Bardez's notes name BE Medium Condensed, which is narrower and heavier than what the PC prints.
|-
| Stat labels (POWER, ABILITY …), type banners (EFFECT, LOST INTERRUPT …), bottom-strip captions, © line || Akzidenz-Grotesk BQ Bold Condensed || Banners are letter-spaced (wide on Effects/Interrupts, tight on starship type lines).
|-
| Destiny, stat values, slip numbers || Akzidenz-Grotesk Medium Extended || Bold for values; slip numbers on the Remaster sheets are zero-padded italic ("01").
|-
| Parsec number (systems) || Craft Gothic Heavy Extended || Per Bardez's notes.
|}

== Sizes (600 DPI, 1632×2220 card with bleed) ==
Sizes from Bardez's ''Card Fonts and dimensions'' notes and the cardmaker standard:
* title 80&nbsp;px; destiny 80
* lore 58 (line 60, first-line indent 60)
* game text 62 (line 65)
* stat labels 56; values 60
* deploy/forfeit 70; banners 60
* bottom strip 48; © line 24
The Holotable image (745×1039) is the 600&nbsp;DPI card at half scale.

== Decipher vs. the Players Committee ==
* Decipher's printed lore face is slightly narrower than the Akzidenz-Grotesk BQ Light Condensed used by Bardez and the PC. Re-typeset lore therefore occasionally runs one line longer than the printed card.
* The PC's Holotable game text is larger than the text on the 2006 Remaster slip sheets, which were sized to fit a printed sleeve insert. The remaster program follows the Holotable size.
* Special Edition and later sets changed the © line wording ("© LUCASFILM LTD. & TM. TM, ® & © 1998 DECIPHER INC.") but not the face.
